findings.suggested_fix: Use a more literal or conventional Hebrew equivalent for “Godly” (e.g., "הבית הנוצרי" or "הבית החסידי" or better: "הבית המְשַׁמֵּשׁ/הבית הקדוש שבּאופי אלוהי") to match nuance. If the translator prefers a short title, "הבית הפרֹש" is not appropriate; recommended: "הבית החסיד" or simply retain "הבית הצדיק" only if the editor confirms this captures the intended nuance.

findings.source_quote: ...for out of it are the issues of life –Proverbs 4:23.
findings.suggested_fix: The current rendering "…מפני שממנו יוצאות תמורות החיים" is awkward and departs from the natural Hebrew idiom. Suggest a clearer translation that preserves the sense: e.g. "…כי ממנו יוצאות מעינות החיים – משלי ד:כג" (or keep the reference format used elsewhere: "–משלי 4:23"). Ensure consistent reference formatting.

findings.source_quote: Eunice was a Jewess, who, upon embracing faith in Christ, found herself in an unequal yoke with a Greek. We read that unfeigned faith was first wrought in her mother Lois, and that affected Eunice.
findings.suggested_fix: The Hebrew phrase "אין לנו תיעוד שאביו הוסיף לאמונה" later is slightly ambiguous/awkward ("הוסיף לאמונה" can read as 'added' rather than 'joined the faith'). Use a clearer Hebrew verb: "הצטרף לאמונה" or "התווסף לאמונה" (better: "הצטרף לאמונה"). Also in this paragraph the name Lois appears as "לוויס (Lois)" — consider using a single natural Hebrew transliteration without the parenthetical English (e.g., "לוויס") for consistency with the rest of the article.
